mapper.select: SELECT l.lecture_id id, l.name title, u.nickname provider, l.thumbnail thumbnail, p.last_update_date last_update_date FROM lecture_content_progress_rate p JOIN lecture l ON p.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN user u ON l.uploader_id = u.user_id WHERE student_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.last_update_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT l.lecture_id lectureId, l.name title, p.progress_rate as progressRate FROM lecture_content_progress_rate p JOIN lecture l ON p.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN user u ON l.uploader_id = u.user_id WHERE student_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.last_update_date DESC LIMIT 1
select COALESCE( (select if(uploader_id = #{userId}, true, false) from lecture where lecture_id = #{lectureId}), false ) as result

SELECT l.lecture_id AS lectureId, l.thumbnail AS thumbnail, l.name AS title, COALESCE(u.nickname, '알 수 없는 사용자') AS nickname, l.introduction AS introduction, l.price AS price, l.discount_rate AS discountRate, COALESCE(review_data.reviewNum, 0) AS reviewNum, COALESCE(review_data.totalReviewRate, 0) AS totalReviewRate, COALESCE(review_data.avgReviewRate, 0.0) AS avgReviewRate, COALESCE(bookmark_data.bookmarkNum, 0) AS bookmarkNum, l.difficulty AS difficulty, COALESCE(category_data.categoryName, '미분류') AS big, COALESCE(category_data.interestedNames, '미분류') AS small FROM lecture l LEFT JOIN user u ON l.uploader_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT lecture_id, COUNT(review_id) AS reviewNum, SUM(review_rate) AS totalReviewRate, ROUND(AVG(review_rate), 2) AS avgReviewRate FROM review GROUP BY lecture_id) review_data ON l.lecture_id = review_data.lecture_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT lecture_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS bookmarkNum FROM lecture_bookmark GROUP BY lecture_id) bookmark_data ON l.lecture_id = bookmark_data.lecture_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT lf.lecture_id, MIN(c.name) AS categoryName, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.name ORDER BY i.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS interestedNames FROM lecture_field lf LEFT JOIN interested i ON i.interested_id = lf.interested_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = i.category_id GROUP BY lf.lecture_id) category_data ON l.lecture_id = category_data.lecture_id ORDER BY l.lecture_id

SELECT l.lecture_id AS lectureId, l.thumbnail AS thumbnail, l.name AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, l.introduction AS introduction, l.price AS price, l.discount_rate AS discountRate, COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS reviewNum, COALESCE(SUM(r.review_rate), 0) AS totalReviewRate, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.review_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(r.review_rate) / COUNT(r.review_id) END AS avgReviewRate, COUNT(lb.user_id) AS bookmarkNum, l.difficulty AS difficulty, c.name AS big, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.name SEPARATOR ',') AS small FROM lecture l JOIN user u ON l.uploader_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN lecture_bookmark lb ON lb.lecture_id = l.lecture_id LEFT JOIN review r ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN lecture_field lf ON l.lecture_id = lf.lecture_id JOIN interested i ON i.interested_id = lf.interested_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = i.category_id JOIN user_interested AS ui ON ui.interested_id = i.interested_id WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY l.lecture_id, c.name

SELECT l.lecture_id AS lectureId, l.thumbnail AS thumbnail, l.name AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, l.introduction AS introduction, l.price AS price, l.discount_rate AS discountRate, COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS reviewNum, COALESCE(SUM(r.review_rate), 0) AS totalReviewRate, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.review_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(r.review_rate) / COUNT(r.review_id) END AS avgReviewRate, COUNT(lb.user_id) AS bookmarkNum, l.difficulty AS difficulty, c.name AS big, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct i.name SEPARATOR ',') AS small FROM lecture l JOIN user u ON l.uploader_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN lecture_bookmark lb ON lb.lecture_id = l.lecture_id LEFT JOIN review r ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN lecture_field AS lf ON l.lecture_id = lf.lecture_id JOIN interested AS i ON i.interested_id = lf.interested_id JOIN category AS c ON c.category_id = i.category_id WHERE c.category_id = #{categoryId} GROUP BY l.lecture_id

SELECT DISTINCT l.lecture_id lectureId, l.thumbnail thumbnail, l.name title, u.nickname nickname, l.introduction introduction, p.progress_rate progressRate, CASE WHEN r.review_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END as hasReview FROM user_lecture ul JOIN lecture l ON ul.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN user u ON l.uploader_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN lecture_content_progress_rate p ON p.student_id = ul.user_id AND p.lecture_id = ul.lecture_id LEFT JOIN review r ON ul.lecture_id = r.lecture_id AND ul.user_id = r.writer_id WHERE ul.user_id = #{userId}
AND (p.progress_rate BETWEEN 0 AND 100 OR p.progress_rate IS NULL)
AND p.progress_rate = 100
AND p.progress_rate BETWEEN 30 AND 100 AND r.review_rate IS NULL

SELECT l.lecture_id AS lectureId, l.uploader_id AS providerId, l.thumbnail AS thumbnail, l.name AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, l.outline AS outline, l.introduction AS introduction, l.price AS price, l.discount_rate AS discountRate, CAST(COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id) / 6, 0) AS unsigned) AS reviewNum, COALESCE(SUM(r.review_rate), 0) AS totalReviewRate, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.review_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(r.review_rate) / COUNT(r.review_id) END AS avgReviewRate, l.student_num AS studentNum, l.difficulty AS difficulty, CAST(COUNT(lb.lecture_id) / 8 AS UNSIGNED) AS bookmarkNum, c.name AS big, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.name SEPARATOR ',') AS small FROM lecture l JOIN user u ON l.uploader_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN lecture_bookmark lb ON lb.lecture_id = l.lecture_id LEFT JOIN review r ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN lecture_field lf ON l.lecture_id = lf.lecture_id JOIN interested i ON i.interested_id = lf.interested_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = i.category_id WHERE l.lecture_id = #{lectureId} GROUP BY l.lecture_id, c.name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lecture_chapter AS lch JOIN lecture_content AS lco ON lch.lecture_chapter_id = lco.lecture_chapter_id WHERE lch.lecture_id = #{lectureId}
SELECT lecture_chapter_id AS chapterId, lc.name, order_num AS orderNum FROM lecture_chapter AS lc JOIN lecture AS l ON l.lecture_id = lc.lecture_id WHERE l.lecture_id = #{lectureId}

SELECT l.lecture_id AS lectureId, l.thumbnail AS thumbnail, l.name AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, p.lecture_price AS price, p.refund_date AS refundDate, l.difficulty as difficulty FROM user_lecture ul JOIN purchase p ON p.buyer_id = ul.user_id AND p.lecture_id = ul.lecture_id JOIN lecture l ON l.lecture_id = ul.lecture_id JOIN user u ON u.user_id = l.uploader_id WHERE p.refund_check = true AND ul.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_lecture ul JOIN purchase p ON p.buyer_id = ul.user_id AND p.lecture_id = ul.lecture_id WHERE p.refund_check = true and ul.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT af.name, af.format FROM lecture_material AS lm JOIN additional_file AS af ON lm.lecture_material_id = af.additional_file_id JOIN lecture_content AS lc ON lc.lecture_material_id = lm.lecture_material_id JOIN lecture_chapter AS lcha ON lcha.lecture_chapter_id = lc.lecture_chapter_id WHERE lcha.lecture_chapter_id = #{lectureChapterId}

SELECT lvm.name FROM lecture_material AS lm join lecture_video_material AS lvm ON lm.lecture_material_id = lvm.lecture_material_id JOIN lecture_content AS lc ON lc.lecture_material_id = lm.lecture_material_id JOIN lecture_chapter AS lcha ON lcha.lecture_chapter_id = lc.lecture_chapter_id WHERE lcha.lecture_chapter_id = #{lectureChapterId}

mapper.select: SELECT l.lecture_id AS lectureId, l.thumbnail AS thumbnail, l.name AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, l.outline AS outline, l.introduction AS introduction, l.price AS price, l.discount_rate AS discountRate, CAST(COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id) / 6, 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS reviewNum, COALESCE(SUM(r.review_rate), 0) / COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS avgReviewRate, l.student_num AS studentNum, l.difficulty AS difficulty, CAST(COUNT(lb.lecture_id) / 8 AS UNSIGNED) AS bookmarkNum, lcpr.progress_rate FROM lecture_bookmark lb RIGHT JOIN lecture l ON lb.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN user u ON l.uploader_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN review r ON r.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN lecture_field lf ON lf.lecture_id = l.lecture_id JOIN interested i ON i.interested_id = lf.interested_id JOIN lecture_content_progress_rate lcpr ON lcpr.lecture_id = l.lecture_id WHERE lcpr.student_id = #{userId} GROUP BY l.lecture_id, l.thumbnail, l.name, u.nickname, l.outline, l.introduction, l.price, l.discount_rate, l.student_num, l.difficulty, lcpr.progress_rate
